verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਉ ਬਚਨ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਨਮ ਲੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: asan basan sa(n)g leene aau bachan keene janam lai saadh sa(n)g sree gur araadh hai ||

en.bdb: This human being brings his food and clothing from the Lord when he takes birth and he promises Him that he will keep company of noble souls and meditate on His name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾਂ ਆਏ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ਦਾਸੀ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਸਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: e'eehaa(n) aae dhaataa bisaraae dhaasee lapaTaae pa(n)ch dhoot bhoot bhram bhramat asaadh hai ||

en.bdb: But once he comes to this world, he forsakes the all-giving God and gets enamored with His maid-servant-maya.. He then wanders in the dragon net of the five demons like lust, anger etc. There is no remedy for his escape.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਮਰਨੋ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਮਝੈ ਨ ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਸੁਪਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saach marano bisaar jeevan mithiaa sa(n)saar samajhai na jeet haar supan samaadh hai ||

en.bdb: Living in this world, a human being remains engrossed in materials which are no better than dreams.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰ ਹੁਇ ਹੈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਲੀਜੀਏ ਜਨੰਮ ਜੀਤ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੮॥
verses.translit_en: aausar hui hai biteet leeje'ee jana(n)m jeet keejeeaai saadh sa(n)g preet agam agaadh hai ||498||

en.bdb: Therefore, O fellow being! the time of this life is passing by. You must win the game of life. Enjoin the holy gathering of saintly souls and develop your love for the infinite Lord.  (498)
